pitch_class_relation.domain: 12 tonics x 2 modes x degrees 1..6 x 2 qualities x 4 inversions x 24 permutations

decision.reason: bass does not realize the declared inversion

bounded_conformance.claim_boundary: Agreement is limited to the declared finite partitions and systematic matrix; it is not global solver/checker equivalence.

absolute_register.domain: 12 target pitch classes x 2 qualities x 4 inversions x every exact S/A/T/B octave placement in the closed bounds
absolute_register.pruning_rationale: The pitch-class partition already classifies incomplete or doubled relations; this partition keeps only exact four-role realizations with the declared bass.

voice_resolution.domain: 12 target pitch classes x target quality policy (minor: fully diminished; major: fully/half diminished) x 4 inversions x 6 voice assignments x 5^4 simultaneous voice motions
voice_resolution.pruning_rationale: Source pitches are octave-normalized because the local tendency predicate depends only on source pitch class and signed melodic delta. Register and destination-triad membership are classified in separate partitions.

complete_verifier.domain: systematic complete-verifier matrix: 2 qualities x 4 inversions x valid/register-fault/resolution-fault
complete_verifier.scope: C major vii7/V -> V two-beat artifacts; this matrix is systematic, not an exhaustive full-composition claim
